evidence_objects.title: Controlled evidence object binding template

binds.requirement: Bound to a named evidence requirement.
binds.identity: Bound to an identity and authority context.
binds.organization: Bound to an organization and jurisdiction.
binds.data: Bound to a dataset, fixture, migration batch, or operational data context.
binds.provider_state: Bound to a recorded provider state.

evidence_objects.reproducibility: Reproduction procedure recorded; a reproducible procedure is not a reproduced result.
evidence_objects.retention_dependency: Retained per the applicable records obligation.
evidence_objects.expiry_or_revalidation_date: Revalidation date recorded per evidence class.
evidence_objects.acceptance_disposition: Not accepted; disposition reserved to the acceptance authority.
